premises.text: Combustion-based power systems are inefficient and emit large amounts of CO2
premises.evidence_span: These combustion power plants fail. They are highly inefficient, they are not flexible, and they emit millions of tons of CO2.

premises.text: A new power generation solution can achieve 80% efficiency and has a carbon-negative footprint
premises.evidence_span: Our solution produces power at a groundbreaking efficiency of 80%. It is fully reversible, and it even has a carbon-negative footprint.

premises.text: The new power plant design eliminates combustion and achieves 100% fuel conversion
premises.evidence_span: In our varying units, we have eliminated the combustion completely. By adding the two components that we showed before to the fuel cells, and operating the system in a closed cycle, we achieve 100% fuel conversion and 80% electric efficiency.

premises.text: The system can produce renewable power from biogas and separate pure CO2
premises.evidence_span: Here, when there is not enough solar or wind power in the power grid, we produce renewable power from the biogas, while separating pure CO2.

premises.text: The reversible operation of the system can increase customer revenues significantly
premises.evidence_span: For our customers, the doubling in electric efficiency first of all means doubling revenues from electricity. With the additional revenues from the reversible operation, they can overall more than five-fold their income.

premises.text: The technology can replace fossil-based power plants globally and has a significant market potential
premises.evidence_span: Globally, by using the available sustainable biogenic resources, we can replace all fossil-based power plants, which is a 7 trillion US dollar market and remove the equivalent of the entire US CO2 emissions from the atmosphere every year.

value.text: The world can benefit from decentralized, carbon-negative, and highly efficient power generation
value.evidence_span: join us to provide the world with decentralized, carbon-negative and highly efficient power plants.

notes: No separate premises for the technology components as they collectively support the main claims.
